source_trace.meaning: live_candidate_slots imports evaluate_candidate, calls it per candidate, skips candidates whose ev.should_buy is false, then copies ev.entry_quality into display fields. EQ is not used as a slot gate here.
evaluate_candidate first calls evaluate_signal, then separately calls assess_shadow_entry_quality and returns both should_buy and entry_quality.
EQ implementation: shadow_entry_quality_v1 follow-through / risk / event-heavy quality filter.
Backtest-style entry signal is evaluate_signal: final_score = raw components * market_adjustment; should_buy = final_score >= rb.signal_threshold.
Elite shadow virtual ledger uses EQ allow as a virtual open filter, but that is a separate live/shadow overlay, not the frozen OOS entry rule itself.
Elite strategy sim also gates virtual entries by entry_quality, again as a separate simulator layer.

classification_reason: EQ is computed after evaluate_signal and uses additional follow-through metrics and heuristics that are not the same as evaluate_signal components or threshold. If used as a gate after should_buy, it becomes an unvalidated extra post-filter over the backtested entry signal.
